name: create_or_transfer_domain
description:
Perform one of two fixed domain operations selected by method: add (the default) adds an existing apex domain to the selected Vercel account; move-in accepts an approved move from another Vercel account. A move-in changes ownership within Vercel and requires a pending move approval for the receiving account. Neither method purchases a domain or transfers its registration from an external registrar. Domains acquired outside MCP can be added with method:add.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v7/domains --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

cdnEnabled.description: Whether the domain has the Vercel CDN enabled or not.

name.description: The domain name you want to add.

token.description: The move-in token from Move Requested email.

zone.description: Whether to create a DNS zone on Vercel. Set `true` if using Vercel nameservers.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
